blocks.html:
Have you ever wondered what the difference is between adding stickers, a partial wrap, and a full wrap?

We here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto have done almost every kind of wrap you can think of with our 20 years of combined experience. We offer Stickers or decals, partial and full wraps. Our installation crew works with our in-house design team to ensure that your ideas are realized. Our installers then apply the vinyl with great care to your vehicle.

Stickers

Stickers or decals are when you add branding or a logo to your car. We have added red racing stripes for customers as you can see an example here. They are considerably easy to install and remove by a professional. Did you know that the first road car to feature racing stripes was a 1965 Ford Mustang GT350? The stripes are nick-named as “go-faster stripes”. We recommend keeping it within the speed limit unless you are looking to get a reputation with the local police. We can also add any company branding or logo to the vehicle as per some of the images below.

This is a great way to market your business while on the road. We have many industries using this form of branding to advertising themselves. We have found that this is a more cost-effective way of getting your message out to the public than conventional advertising. This is our most popular service and can normally be done within 24 to 48 hours depending on size and layout.

Partial Wrap

Partial wraps are a great option if you are happy with the colour and finish of the vehicle. Most clients would just like to make a statement or add custom details without wrapping the whole vehicle. Our design team can work with you to show you the different options available and give you a mock-up of the finished product before any vinyl is even printed and cut. This can also be completed within 24-48 hours.

Full Wrap

Full or complete wraps can change the whole feel and look of your vehicle. We here at Vinyl Wrap Toronto love doing full wraps and seeing the customer’s reaction to their almost-new vehicle. Full wraps mean every surface of the car is covered in vinyl. We work with the client to specify if they want bumpers wrapped, windows tinted, and door creases included. The more detailed the wrap, the more expensive the job can be. Call us at 416-746-1381 to get a quote.
